attributes: Opportunity Type, Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Owner Name
goal: Track sales pipeline health by monitoring opportunity creation and progression across different stages (M1, S0, S1) to optimize revenue generation performance.
user_context: Sales managers and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly pipeline reviews to track opportunity creation velocity across different funnel stages (M1, S0, S1), analyzing both count and ACV metrics by individual contributors, teams, and lead sources to identify performance trends, compare team effectiveness, assess pipeline health progression from early-stage to qualified opportunities, and make data-driven decisions about resource allocation and coaching needs while focusing on non-closed-won deals from new customers and existing customer expansions.
